acceptanceCriteria: The docs and the accepted relation set agree.
An invalid relation names the row ordinal, the value and the accepted set.
body: Found in V1-0913 (2026-10-11). DOGFOOD_CITATIONS accepts only `test-claim` as a test relation, while the docs list `test`. A row using `test` fails with only `invalid-arguments`, without naming the row or the accepted relations.

title: DOGFOOD_CITATIONS rejects relation `test` with bare invalid-arguments
